milestones.title: Implement 22 Orang Asli village water-supply projects
milestones.description: Rubiah announced RM3 million under RP1 RMK13 for system upgrades, pipe improvements and tube wells during 2026.
milestones.progress_note: The funding and programme scope are reported. Completed-project counts and physical progress were not verified. The separate number of villages already served and earlier RMK12 spending are not completion of these 22 projects; the annual allocation is not converted into an exact completion deadline.

milestones.title: Advance the Biya–Jabir road project to tender
milestones.description: Willie reported obtaining federal approval and resolving land-compensation discussions, with the road project recently put out to tender.
milestones.progress_note: A dated procurement-stage report, with funding and implementation shared by the relevant agencies. Tendering does not prove contract award, construction, a finished road or a completion percentage.
